1.explanation: Pagination.js defines the default itemRangeText and pageRangeText functions that always append the plural “items” and “pages.” These should be updated to check if the count is 1 and switch to the singular form. The experimental version (experimental/Pagination.js) repeats the same logic and therefore must also be adjusted. Finally, the Pagination-test.js file contains assertions expecting the plural labels; these tests must be updated to reflect the new singular behavior when there is only one item or one page.
1.bug_scenario: The pagination footer is displaying plural labels for singular cases. For example, when there is only one page it shows “of 1 pages” (and similarly “items” when there is only one item) instead of using the singular “page” or “item.” This is unexpected and should be fixed so that when max === 1 or totalPages === 1 the singular noun is used.
